title: Binance Will Add Movement (MOVE) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Movement (MOVE)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin ,  Binance Auto-Invest , and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn MOVE Flexible Products  listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2024-12-09 12:00 (UTC)  and is  available for subscription . From  2024-12-10 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase MOVE using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy MOVE with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay,  or buy and sell MOVE with their  wallet balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of MOVE being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading MOVE against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of MOVE being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add MOVE as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  MOVE/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-12-09 14:00 (UTC). Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M MOVE Perpetual Contract  at  2024-12-09 14:00 (UTC) , with up to 75x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M MOVE Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract MOVEUSDT Launch Time  2024-12-09 14:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset Movement (MOVE) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size To be confirmed Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the MOVEUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2024-12-09 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-12-09 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-12-10 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-12-10 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the MOVEUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the MOVEUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the MOVEUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The MOVEUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
